## Error codes

Every error returned by tronlib v2 is `*tron.Error` carrying a `Code` (machine-readable), an `Op` (the failing operation), a `Hint` (remediation), and a `Next` action. The table below is generated from the package source — hand edits between the markers are reverted by CI. `Error()` prints only `op: code`, so read the rest with `tron.ErrorOf(err)`, and match codes with `tron.HasCode(err, code)` rather than comparing messages.

| Code | Action | Doc |
|---|---|---|
<!-- go:errors -->
| `account.insufficient_balance` | `fund` | the account lacks the required balance |
| `account.insufficient_bandwidth` | `fund` | the account lacks the bandwidth required for this transaction |
| `account.insufficient_energy` | `fund` | the account lacks the energy required for this call |
| `account.permission_denied` | `fix_call` | the signer lacks permission for this operation |
| `address.invalid` | `fix_call` | the value is not a valid TRON address |
| `address.wrong_prefix` | `fix_call` | the address's network prefix is not TRON's (0x41) |
| `amount.decimals_mismatch` | `fix_call` | the operands have different decimals |
| `amount.invalid` | `fix_call` | an amount argument failed validation |
| `amount.negative` | `fix_call` | a negative amount was supplied |
| `amount.overflow` | `fix_call` | the amount overflows the integer representation |
| `amount.too_many_decimals` | `fix_call` | the amount has more decimal places than the token allows |
| `chain.closed` | `retry` | the connection to the node is closed |
| `chain.connection` | `retry` | the node could not be reached |
| `chain.network_mismatch` | `fix_call` | the endpoint is on a different TRON network than expected |
| `chain.timeout` | `retry` | the node did not respond in time |
| `chain.unavailable` | `retry` | the node is unavailable (server error or maintenance) |
| `chain.unconfirmed` | `wait` | the transaction was broadcast but is not yet confirmed |
| `contract.arg_mismatch` | `fix_call` | the arguments do not match the method's ABI signature |
| `contract.bad_abi` | `fix_call` | the provided ABI could not be parsed |
| `contract.bad_metadata` | `fix_call` | the contract's metadata violates the expected layout |
| `contract.method_unknown` | `fix_call` | the method name is not present in the contract ABI |
| `contract.no_abi` | `fix_call` | no ABI was provided for the contract |
| `contract.not_found` | `fix_call` | no contract exists at the given address |
| `contract.result_type_mismatch` | `fix_call` | the result accessor does not match the ABI return type |
| `event.unknown` | `fix_call` | no registered event definition matches this log's signature, or two conflicting layouts are registered for it; register the emitting contract's ABI (event.RegisterABIJSONForAddress) before decoding |
| `key.invalid` | `fix_call` | the private key is not a valid secp256k1 key |
| `key.mnemonic_invalid` | `fix_call` | the mnemonic phrase is invalid |
| `receipt.failed` | `fix_transaction` | the transaction was processed but failed |
| `receipt.out_of_energy` | `fix_transaction` | the transaction exceeded its energy budget; raise fee_limit or stake energy for the account |
| `receipt.reverted` | `fix_transaction` | the contract execution reverted |
| `rpc.method_failed` | `retry` | the node rejected or failed an rpc; retry with backoff, and if the error repeats identically switch node or method rather than looping |
| `tx.already_signed` | `fix_call` | the transaction is already signed |
| `tx.duplicate` | `wait` | this txid was already broadcast or executed; poll its receipt instead of resending |
| `tx.expired` | `fix_transaction` | the transaction's expiration has passed |
| `tx.fee_limit_too_low` | `fix_transaction` | the fee limit is below the node's minimum |
| `tx.invalid_argument` | `fix_call` | a transaction parameter failed validation |
| `tx.no_signer` | `fix_transaction` | the transaction has no signer attached |
| `tx.tapos_invalid` | `fix_transaction` | the node rejected the transaction's reference block (TAPOS_ERROR) |
| `tx.too_large` | `fix_transaction` | the transaction exceeds the node's size limit (TOO_BIG_TRANSACTION_ERROR) |
| `tx.unknown_contract` | `fix_call` | the referenced contract type is unknown to the SDK |
<!-- /go:errors -->

## Recovery semantics

- `retry` — back off and repeat; safe, the call had no effect
- `wait` — the call may have landed; poll the receipt, do NOT resend
- `fix_call` — change an argument; retrying is pointless
- `fix_transaction` — rebuild with different parameters, re-sign, re-broadcast
- `fund` — acquire a resource, then retry the identical call
- `bug` — stop; the invariant is the library's
- `unset` — Error.Next was never set; Action comes from Code.Action()
